svg.title: Subject-ID portal and structural MRI pipeline
svg.desc: A single subject ID, generated once by the subject-ID portal, is carried unchanged from enrolment through the MRI scan, XNAT, BIDS conversion, T1 staging, batch FreeSurfer recon-all and an automated completion check. The portal writes to Google Sheets and cross-checks XNAT to flag missing records. No subject data is shown.
svg.text: One place an ID is made
Generates a compliant ID for each
Writes the enrolment record to Google Sheets,
one folder, one file per subject
